chunks: Say: 'This is what has been revealed to me: Your God is one and only God.' So will you bow in homage to Him?
ai.seo_question: What is the message of divine unity revealed to the Prophet in Surah Al-Anbiya?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Anbiya, this verse underscores the continuity of the prophetic message, affirming that the core revelation to all prophets is the oneness of God (Tawhid). It serves as a direct call to the polytheists of Mecca to accept Islam, highlighting the Shia emphasis on the unity of divine command across all eras. The rhetorical question challenges listeners to align their hearts with this singular truth, linking belief to practical submission.
